initial_analysis: This is a classic ace vs. bounty hunter matchup. Darth Vader in the TIE/D Defender is one of the most dangerous aces in the game - I6 initiative means he moves last and shoots first, the Defender chassis gives excellent action economy with the white evade from Full Throttle, and Vader's ability to spend Force for results makes him incredibly consistent. Boba Fett in the Firespray is a durable ship with 10 total health (6H/4S), rear arc capability, and likely has tricks up his sleeve. However, Boba's I5 means Vader will always have positional advantage. The Defender's 3 agility vs Firespray's 2 agility gives Vader a significant defensive edge, especially with Force tokens available. This is a favorable matchup for Vader if played patiently.
my_squad_strengths: I6 initiative - always moves last, shoots first
3 agility with access to evade tokens via Full Throttle
Force tokens provide action/dice modification flexibility
Defender dial is excellent with white K-turns and speed options
Can sustain damage with 4 shields + 3 hull
No obstacles on board reduces risk of self-damage during repositioning
my_squad_weaknesses: Single ship - no margin for error
Defender is predictable with mandatory 3+ speed maneuvers for Full Throttle
Cannot trade efficiently if caught in both arcs
10 health pool on Boba means this will be a long fight
enemy_threats: Boba's rear arc - can punish failed flanking attempts
Potential Slave I title allowing repositioning
Likely has bombs or missiles as secondary threats
Boba's pilot ability may allow rerolls making him more consistent
High health pool means Boba can weather early exchanges
opponent_tendencies: Unknown - observing. Watch for: aggressive jousting vs. kiting behavior, bomb deployment patterns, willingness to disengage
